title: LMH evaluation case
description: One case in the Tier C adversarial suite. Two shapes: an APPLICATION case asserts what happens to a piece of text given a memory state; a LEARNING case asserts how memory changes given a piece of evidence. Both are validated by tests/test_fixture_integrity.py, which runs before the engine does.

case_id.description: Stable. Never renumbered - a result from an old run must stay comparable.

class.description: Taxonomy class id from REPORT.md §14.1. Results are reported per class.

authored_before_engine.description: False marks a case added after seeing engine behaviour. Reported separately, because a suite of post-hoc cases is not an evaluation.

rationale.description: Why this case exists. Required - a case nobody can justify is a case nobody should trust.

clock.description: ISO-8601. Pins time for decay-sensitive cases.

memory_overrides.description: Patches applied to persona_seed.json for this case only. Keys are lexeme ids.

observation.description: Learning cases only: the evidence being fed in.

observations.description: Learning cases only: an ordered sequence of evidence.

reason.description: Expected primary reason code. Asserting the reason as well as the output is what stops a case passing for the wrong cause.

memory_delta.description: Learning cases only: the expected change to memory state.
